text: This report recommends that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) privately owned tree located at 6 Argyle Street. The applicant is requesting removal due to concerns that the tree has damaged a clay sewer line, resulting in recurring plumbing issues, and that the tree is too large for the yard. The subject tree is a poplar (Populus sp.), measuring 68 cm in diameter. The Private Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
Item TE34.72 was withdrawn from the agenda.
